integrity: An all-parameter proof using a row/column cover, Alexander duality, a nerve sphere, and a null-map homotopy pushout; independent audit not performed.
limitations: Nonequivariant homotopy equivalence for p,q>=2. No PL, simple-homotopy, or independent verification assertion. Finite checks are supplementary.
title: Three-sphere homotopy types of rook-graph dominance complexes
